text:
marco: Quick design idea for prompt-sets/evals approvals: show an inline audit trail entry when someone bulk-approves (user, count, optional reason), accessible from the row and from the toast. goal: better context than an ephemeral toast and a lightweight way to add a short reason.
anya: sketch?
marco: figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/Approval-Audit (mock). Inline history below the header: 'Marco approved 3 prompt sets · 11m ago · View' clicking View expands inline history with reason and a small Revert action. Also toast after approve: 'Approved 3 prompt sets — Undo · View history'.
kevin: backend note: we'll need an approvals API that records actor, ids, timestamp, and optional comment. can batch. also need endpoints for revert by approval id.
asha: a11y first pass: audit entries must be keyboard-focusable, have clear aria-labels, and the expand action should not trap focus. For the toast, use role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true" and include aria-controls pointing to the expanded inline history. Do NOT move focus on toast.
jessica: microcopy: prefer verb-first toast: 'Approved 3 prompt sets. Undo · View history'. For inline row: 'Marco approved 3 prompt sets — "Quick cleanup for duplicates"' (reason optional, truncate with '...') with a link 'Revert'.
kevin: question: if someone reverts from history, do we show another audit entry 'Reverted by X'? That seems important.
marco: yes, append a new audit entry so timeline shows revert actions. show small animation and announce to SR: 'Reverted 3 prompt sets by Marco' via the same offscreen live region.
elevate-bot: Approval record created: id=appr_2026_0001, actor=marco, count=3
kevin: dev acceptance criteria draft: (1) create approval audit record on bulk-approve, (2) show inline compact audit pill + expandable details, (3) toast with Undo & View history (aria-live role=status), (4) keyboard + SR accessible expand and revert flows, (5) revert creates new audit entry, (6) analytics events approval.created and approval.reverted.
anja: small UX ask: show a subtle divider when history is expanded so it's visually grouped.
asha: focus rules: when user opens inline history via keyboard, focus should land on the first interactive control inside it (Revert or comment link) and Esc should close the expansion and return focus to the audit pill. No focus traps.
jessica: length of reason field: inline UI should show 120 chars max, with a 'More' link to open a lightweight modal with full comment if needed. modal must be accessible but try to keep main path inline.
kevin: will add API spec and annotate events. I'll implement batches and the revert API. adding unit + e2e tests and NVDA/VoiceOver smoke tests.
audIT-bot: Audit log updated for approval.appr_2026_0001.
deploy-bot: UAT deployed to feature/approval-audit-inline for testing.
marco: assigning implementation to @kevin, SR tests to @asha, UX polish to @jessica. Thanks all!
